messages:
olivia: Heads up — apiserver watch backlog in eu-west1, p95 watch processing up to ~7s and controller-manager restarts observed. Suspect ARP/neighbor table pressure on GPU nodes.
ben: Seeing similar spike. Correlates with a GPU attach churn window earlier and a couple NAT SNAT alerts. Any packet drops in node logs?
carlos: From apiserver: `watch_event_processing_time: p50=12ms p95=7.2s p99=9.1s`. controller-manager had OOM kills during attach storms. Kernel dmesg shows `neigh: table overflow` on several nodes.
olivia: Yup — `neigh` overflow indicates ARP cache thrash. A lot of ephemeral pods doing host networking -> huge neighbor churn. I ran `ip -s neigh show` and see lots of FAILED/STALE entries.
maya: Can we check GC thresholds? We usually set `net.ipv4.neigh.default.gc_thresh1/2/3` higher on gpu-onboard nodes. Might've been reset by that recent kernel package.
infra-bot: alert: controlplane.watch.latency.euwest1 firing; 3m avg p95 > 5s
ben: I'll push a daemonset patch to bump GC to `4096 8192 16384` and restart kube-proxy on the affected nodes. Quick mitigation to reduce FAILED entries. Thoughts on iptables/NAT sizing too?
carlos: GC bump should buy time. Longer term: reduce watch fanout (prefix/KV caching on apiserver) and throttle attach concurrency from the autoscaler. Also reserve SNAT slots for onboarding bursts.
olivia: Agree. Product impact note: throttling autoscaler increases provisioning delay and could surface as higher customer latency — need product signoff. @maya can you triage?
maya: Filed PROD-8712, product ok with a staged onboarding rollout for critical zones. Also will schedule a kernel-param canary on 2 nodes before fleet-wide.
ben: Rolling patch to 4 nodes now, will monitor. If p95 falls below 500ms we roll rest of the cluster. ETA ~12m.
carlos: :thumbsup:
infra-bot: update: controlplane.watch.latency.euwest1 resolved (p95=420ms)
olivia: Nice. Actions: postmortem, add runbook step to check `ip neigh`/GC thresholds on GPU nodes, add automated GC threshold reapply after node updates, and open umbrella ticket for staged onboarding + SNAT reservations.
maya: Adding runbook bullets and rough cost impact estimate to PROD-8712. Thanks everyone.
